answer_1.quote: We evaluate the quality of CCKGs against manually created CSK graphs... Manual annotation shows that CCKGs achieve high recall and precision for capturing implicit CSK.
answer_1.outputs: Contextualized Commonsense Knowledge Graphs (CCKGs) that explicate argumentative premises and conclusions

answer_2.quote: We measure precision, recall and F1-scores for concepts and triplets... We also include two graph structure metrics: normalized graph edit distance (GED) and G-BERTScore (G-BS).

answer_4.quote: Two independent expert annotators manually labeled all 199 support instances... Q4: To estimate the recall we asked if the graph shows the implicit connection completely, partially or not at all. Q5: each individual triplet had to be labeled as positive, neutral, unrelated or negative.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered a series of questions (Q1–Q5) about plausibility, presence of implicit CSK, and rated each triplet as positive (expresses implicit CSK), neutral (in‑topic), unrelated, or negative (contradicts).
